reason: A DSH plugin for managing user-provided lorebooks as local Markdown and prompt presets, then using that context for fiction writing or interactive roleplay.

summaries.zh: 将酒馆角色卡与世界书导入为本地设定文档，并利用设定上下文生成小说正文或互动角色扮演内容。
summaries.en: Imports TavernAI and SillyTavern character cards and worldbooks into local setting documents for context-aware fiction writing and interactive roleplay.

capabilities: Imports TavernAI and SillyTavern character cards and worldbooks
Stores worldbook data and editable Markdown documents locally
Injects worldbook content into prompts using full-text or keyword-triggered context
Generates fiction prose and roleplay responses from user-provided settings
